North:
- Taxable cash: $170,000 salary + 10% bonus ($17,000) = $187,000
- After-tax cash at 30%: $187,000 × 0.70 = $130,900
- Retirement match: 5% × $170,000 = $8,500, under $20,000 cap = $8,500
- Equity vested by month 12: $160,000 / 4 years = $40,000
- First-year value: $130,900 + $8,500 + $40,000 = $179,400

South:
- Taxable cash: $140,000 salary + 0% bonus = $140,000
- After-tax cash at 30%: $140,000 × 0.70 = $98,000
- Retirement match: 5% × $140,000 = $7,000, under $9,000 cap = $7,000
- Equity vested by month 12: $0
- First-year value: $98,000 + $7,000 + $0 = $105,000

North has the higher first-year value.
